scope: Next 20 sequential pending website records indices 582–698, covering Georgia, Israel, Croatia, London, Dresden, Athens, Cyprus and Istanbul; skipped 2026-11-13 previously checked or no-website entries.
publication: No January 2027 source-dated eligible events confirmed; events.json unchanged.

important_venue_flags.finding: Sauna Paradise specifically advertises bisexual parties for men and women; men-only status must not be presumed.
Sauna Club Tel Aviv officially states men-only, but ticket calendar has no January 2027 date.
Valentino has dated March 2027 events, not January.

entries.Name: Horoom at Bassiani
entries.january_findings: Bassiani/Horoom official website is a JavaScript application with no accessible textual schedule; no official independently dated January 2027 men's darkroom event verified. Needs calendar/social review.

entries.Name: Tel Aviv Pride
entries.january_findings: Tel Aviv LGBTQ Center's official Pride information contains no January 2027 event date. Pride is a broad public community festival and not itself a men-only darkroom event.

entries.Name: Sauna Paradise
entries.january_findings: Sauna Paradise Tel Aviv official website advertises a 'next party for bisexual men & women' dated 5 August 2026. The page has no confirmed January 2027 events and includes mixed-gender attendance; do not classify all sessions men-only.

entries.Name: Lokrum Island
entries.january_findings: Lokrum Island official public nature reserve/tourist site lists transport, tickets and environmental rules, not a men-only party calendar. Public-area cruising listing should be researched separately from formal events.

entries.Name: Hyde Park — Rose Garden
entries.january_findings: Hyde Park official Royal Parks visitor page contains public park amenities and general organised events, not specific gay men's cruising party dates. Maintain cruising-area research separately; do not infer activity from an official park website.

entries.Name: Pickup Men's Club
entries.january_findings: Pickup Men's Club Dresden official site confirms daily late-night opening and describes an underwear cruising party and Pup Play, but the party page provides no individual January 2027 dates. Recurrence cannot be assigned automatically.

entries.Name: Saxxim
entries.january_findings: Saxxim Dresden official URL returned a 502 error; no individually dated January 2027 eligible men's darkroom event could be established.

entries.Name: Valentino
entries.january_findings: Valentino Dresden official site announces Tuntenball 6 March 2027 and warm-up at Valentino 5 March 2027, outside January; general gay café not a confirmed men's darkroom venue.

entries.Name: Del Sol Café
entries.january_findings: Official Del Sol Café Athens page provides gay café contact and social links but no event calendar or individually dated January 2027 men's cruising event.

entries.Name: Rooster
entries.january_findings: Official Rooster Athens site is a café/restaurant with all-day food, music and art displays; no men-only darkroom party calendar or January 2027 date.

entries.Name: Eagle London
entries.january_findings: Official Eagle London homepage publishes recurring nightlife brands and event listings from August 2026 on the accessible version, not dated January 2027 men-only darkroom parties. Do not extrapolate Bear Bash or other weekly programmes.

entries.Name: Accept – LGBTI Cyprus
entries.january_findings: Official Accept LGBTI Cyprus website resolves to /home/ and describes community rights, support and projects; it is not a men-only darkroom organiser calendar, and no January 2027 eligible date is listed.

entries.Name: Queer Wave
entries.january_findings: Official Queer Wave Cyprus is an inclusive queer film festival; its programme says Coming Soon and archives prior years, with no January 2027 male-only darkroom party.

entries.Name: Callas TLV
entries.january_findings: Official Callas TLV page timed out in web retrieval; no confirmed men-only January 2027 darkroom date available through this source.

entries.Name: MUSCLES TLV
entries.january_findings: Official MUSCLES TLV ticket organiser profile lists upcoming August/September 2026 fetish parties and earlier dates including Saturday 10 January 2026 (not 2027). No January 2027 confirmed date.

entries.Name: SCHWARZE
entries.january_findings: Official SCHWARZE ticket profile identifies men-only fetish events but displays a 14 August 2026 upcoming event and older 2026 dates, with no January 2027 listing.

entries.Name: Sauna Club Tel Aviv
entries.january_findings: Sauna Club Tel Aviv official website confirms men-only sauna with event ticket calendar. Linked Chillz organiser schedule publishes dated July 2026 sessions, no January 2027 confirmed date.

entries.Name: Tel Aviv LGBTQ Center
entries.january_findings: Official Tel Aviv LGBTQ Center homepage provides community services, clinic and Pride information but no January 2027 specifically men-only darkroom event; separate listing from Pride shares the same organisation.

entries.Name: Havruta Party
entries.january_findings: Havruta official national activity calendar presents LGBTQ religious/community meetings dated primarily June–August 2026; no independently dated January 2027 male-only darkroom party. Community parties are not assumed cruise-focused.

entries.Name: Cheeky Club
entries.january_findings: Official Cheeky Club Istanbul restaurant/bar page lists location and amenities, no event programme or January 2027 men-only darkroom event.
